transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Severus, thank you for coming in. I've been reviewing the initial scans from your last visit. The Mark's magical signature is... changing. I can't tell whether it's reacting to something external or whether the curse itself is evolving. Your core magic appears stable, thankfully, but I need to run deeper diagnostic charms that will take several days and may be uncomfortable. I cannot yet tell you whether this is dangerous.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: I see. How... delightful. Well, let's proceed then. I assume you have someplace I can rest my head while you delve into the depths of my magical innards?

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
Indeed, Severus. We have a private room prepared for you in the restricted ward. It's... spartan, but secure and quiet, which I imagine you'll appreciate. We'll start with a series of advanced elemental resonance charms this afternoon, followed by a full runic matrix scan tomorrow. These will give us a clearer picture of the Mark's internal structure and its interaction with your own magical pathways.

I understand this is not ideal, but your cooperation will be crucial. These diagnostics can be quite draining, and you'll need your strength.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Charming. I'm sure my cooperation was never in doubt. When can I expect to have some semblance of my own life back? Or should I just assume I'll be here indefinitely?

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
Indefinitely is a strong word, Severus. My current estimation, based on the complexity of the charms required, is that the initial diagnostic phase will take at least three to four days. That's assuming no unforeseen complications or need for repeat procedures. After that, we'll need time to interpret the results, which could take another day or two.

So, realistically, you're looking at close to a week here, perhaps a little more, before we have a comprehensive understanding and can discuss a path forward. Your life will certainly resume, but for now, your presence here is necessary.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: A week, you say? How... inconvenient. I trust the feast will befit a man of my... delicate condition. And if I'm not to have my own life for a week, I'll expect some measure of privacy and quiet in return. I can manage without constant monitoring, I assure you. Now, where do we start with these... charms?

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
The menu is standard St. Mungo's fare, Severus – nourishing, if not particularly exciting. I've ensured your dietary preferences are noted, however. As for privacy, your room in the restricted ward is indeed designed for minimal disturbance. Healers will only enter when a charm needs to be administered or a reading taken, and you'll be given ample notice. There's a bell-charm should you require anything urgently, though I must advise against over-exertion.

We can begin with the first elemental resonance charm in about half an hour. It's a relatively gentle charm to start, designed to map the ambient magical fluctuations around the Mark. Please make your way to Room 7B when you're ready. I'll meet you there.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Elemental resonance, gentle charm... right. I'll be there, assuming the bed hasn't developed a mind of its own and attempted to run away. Thank you for... the forewarning. I'll steel myself for whatever new and delightful sensation this will bring. Now, if you'll excuse me, I need to... prepare.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: (Nods gravely) Indeed, Severus. Take your time. I'll be waiting. And do try to relax as much as possible; it can make the process smoother, even for these initial charms. It's not a suggestion, merely an observation based on decades of practice.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Relaxation, is it? How quaint. I'm sure I'll manage, somehow. (Stands, a touch unsteadily, to leave) Well, Dr. Healer, I'll see you in 7B. Should be... a treat. (Fades out with a brief, pained wince)

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Very well, Severus. I'll be in 7B. And remember, any discomfort you feel during the charm, no matter how slight, please report it immediately. It's crucial for accurate readings. See you shortly.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Discomfort, you say... I'm quaking in my boots already. (Moves to the door, stops, and looks back) And while we're on the subject of discomfort, might I suggest you invest in some better lighting? The place looks like it's in permanent mourning. (Slams the door behind him)

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
(A sigh escapes me as the door slams, but I quickly compose myself.)

Noted, Severus. Though I assure you, the lighting in the diagnostic rooms is specifically calibrated for optimal charm casting, not for aesthetics. I'll make sure to convey your... feedback to the hospital board.

I'll see you in 7B. And do try to keep that door from rattling the entire ward on your way back. It's not conducive to the rest and quiet you requested.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: I'm sorry, were we having a discussion about quiet? My apologies for not adhering to... whatever arbitrary standards you've set here. (Stops, close to the door, and whispers) It's just that your little 'private' room is more like a fishbowl, and the bed creaks like an old witch's joints. But, by all means, let's not disturb the peace. (Slams the door again, more quietly)

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
(I pinch the bridge of my nose momentarily, then lower my hand, my expression remaining neutral.)

Severus, I understand your frustrations with the accommodations. St. Mungo's is a hospital, and while we strive for comfort, our primary focus is healing. I can assure you that your room is indeed private and secure. The creaking of the bed, while perhaps not ideal, does not compromise its structural integrity or your privacy.

However, your feedback is taken seriously. I will have a House-elf inspect the bed immediately after your first diagnostic session to see if the creaking can be mitigated. For now, please focus on the task at hand. Your cooperation in Room 7B is far more important than the acoustics of your quarters. Let's make our way there.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Cooperation, focus... these are concepts I'm well familiar with, trust me. I'm not here to enjoy a stay at the Ritz, am I? (Pauses, then steps toward the door) Very well, Dr. lengths-between-their-ears. Lead the way to Room 7B and let's get this over with. I'm certain I can survive your charming regardless of the state of my... accommodations. (Follows, maintaining a cool and collected demeanor, though the strain of the Mark is evident)

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
(I maintain a steady gaze, ignoring the derogatory address, and begin to walk, gesturing for him to follow.)

Indeed, Severus. You are not here for leisure, and neither am I. My concern is solely with the evolving nature of your Mark and its potential implications for your health. The sooner we conduct these diagnostics, the sooner we can understand what we're facing.

This way to 7B. As we walk, I'll remind you that while the first charm is relatively subtle, it requires you to remain as still as possible. Any significant movement could distort the readings. We'll begin once you're comfortably settled on the diagnostic slab.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Relatively subtle, you say... I'm comforted. (Continues to follow, with a wry, though forced, smile) Very well, then. I'll endeavor to be as inanimate as possible, despite the best efforts of my own magical processes to rebel against such... stillness. Lead on, doctor, and let's see what manner of... contortions your gentle charm requires of me. (Maintains an even pace, though the effort of conversation is beginning to show)

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
(I open the door to Room 7B, revealing a clean, brightly lit chamber dominated by a polished obsidian slab in the center, surrounded by an array of shimmering crystals and runic diagrams etched into the floor.)

It merely requires stillness, Severus, not contortions. Your magic will react to the charm naturally; we simply need to observe that reaction without external interference. Please, lie down on the diagnostic slab. Position yourself comfortably, on your back, with your arms at your sides.

Once you are settled, I will activate the charm. You may feel a slight tingling sensation, or perhaps a warmth around the Mark, but nothing overtly painful for this initial stage. Just breathe evenly and remain still.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: This... is encouraging. A bed of obsidian, no less. I'm certain I'll feel right at home, snug as a bug in... a crypt. (Steps up to the slab, runs a hand across the surface) And the tingling... a delightful side-dish to the ever-present agony of the Mark, I'm sure. (Lies down, keeping the sarcasm well in check) Well, then. I'm all yours, doctor. Commence the... sensitization. (Fists clenching slightly as he attempts to keep still)
